chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense, All Streams Flow to the Sea, and Itto - Oni Rush in damage mode, all targeting Sludge Spinner.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered replacing Itto - Oni Rush with Coral Guard and Water's Edge, dealing less damage but gaining 5 Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up all defense, so I accepted the telegraphed 8 damage in exchange for dealing as much immediate damage as possible.
q4_different_intent: Yes. A substantially larger attack intent would have made me include Block, likely using Itto - Oni Rush in Block mode and/or Coral Guard.
